resources.string: PyroWave: find the fastest speed the host can send whole frames to this device
PyroWave frame pace: %1$d Mbps. Tap to calibrate again.

The host sends test frames at different speeds, and Nightjar keeps the fastest speed at which whole frames arrive. PyroWave streams then use it. Stop any stream on this PC first. This takes one to three minutes.
Frame pace: %1$d Mbps on this %2$d Mbps connection. Saved for this PC.
No tested speed met every loss limit. The best, %1$d Mbps on this %2$d Mbps connection, is saved for this PC. Some picture damage may remain.
Frame pacing needs the wired link speed of this device or of the PC, and neither is known.
The stream already needs %1$d Mbps, too close to this %2$d Mbps connection. Lower the bitrate first.
The PC is streaming or already running a test. Stop the stream and try again.
This PC can\'t test frame pacing. It needs a host with PyroWave pacing tests.
The calibration could not be completed. Check the connection and try again.
